_doc: Levels: target_lufs = integrated LUFS of the slice on the music/ambience bus before ducking, on the scale where the voice files sit at -20 LUFS (audition with voice + music + beds, no SFX: voice over bed +15.8 dB short-term median; SFX bring it to the bible's +13..+15).
Hook board data (S00-L001..L023 + S01-L001). Source of tools/build_hook_timeline.py -> episodes/hook/timeline.json + SHOTS.md.
Plan in prose: docs/HOOK_BOARD.md. Voice takes: audio/voice_lines.json. Music/SFX picks: docs/CUE_PICKS.md, audio/music_map.json.
{hit:'H2'} (music sync point below), {end:true} (timeline end); each may add off (s).
LINES: placed in order. gap = speech gap (s) from the previous line's last word end to this line's first word onset;
onset = an anchor for the first word onset instead (music-locked lines and lines that follow a designed picture beat).
captions: chunks separated by ' / ' (1-3 words each, {WORD|colour} keywords), else the engine chunker (maxWords 3).
SHOTS: start = anchor; a shot ends where the next starts; the last ends at timeline.end. tin = transition into the shot.

timeline_end.note: DAY 1 card impact (D1 + 0.12, cardSlam impact) + 1.1 s

H2.note: Our Last Stand hit 2 peak (src 6.495) 50 ms before 'One'

H3.note: hit 3 (src 7.455) one bar (4 beats at 130 BPM) after H2: room for the A3 tree-flip gag

H4.note: hit 4 (src 8.355) 3 beats (1.385 s at 130 BPM) after H3: a deadpan beat before 'No undo.'

SLAM.note: Our Last Stand full-band slam (src 19.395) on the A8 cut (Sam to camera)

TOAST.note: Gotta Catch That Unicorn groove downbeat (src 2.392) on the toast

DAY1.note: Average Duck Face downbeat (src 8.87) on the DAY 1 card impact

FLARE.note: the moon flares into a sun on 'little' (payoff word)

lines.captions: What if / {REAL LIFE|yellow} / had a / {SETTINGS|cyan} menu?
In my defense... / I only changed / {ONE|orange} thing.

shots.name: A1_dogsize
shots.picture: Phone POV on the street (day): Sam's hand, DOG SIZE slider; Tiny on Kevin's lawn grows in 3 steps synced to slider ticks, house-size on 'menu?' (head leaves the top of frame, mailbox squashes).
shots.camera: push 4%; small shake on every growth step; 1.15x punch toward Tiny on 'menu?'
shots.faces: Tiny happy -> excited, tongue out, tail wag faster each step
shots.ui: slider value bubble SMALL -> BIG -> HOUSE
shots.sfx: ui_tap; slider_tick x3; slide_whistle_up[0]; boing on each growth settle; impact on the final step

shots.name: A2_oneapp
shots.picture: 'One app.' The REALITY SETTINGS gear icon flies at the lens and fills it.
shots.camera: snap zoom in through the icon (zoomThrough into A3, 8 frames, expo)
shots.ui: appIcon with gloss and glow ring; call ctx.portal(iconRect) so the zoomThrough follows the icon
shots.sfx: whoosh_short + impact_hit (on the H2 hit)

shots.name: A3_treeflip
shots.picture: The tree flips: a second slider (TREE up/down) flips Kevin's tree upside down, roots up, soil clods fall. Kevin (sunglasses, leaf blower) frozen mid-blow.
shots.camera: lands from the zoomThrough with a short whip-settle (in-shot), slight tilt
shots.sfx: zip; cartoon_pop; bonk as the crown hits the lawn (this 1.1 s voice gap is the tree-flip sound gag)

shots.name: A4_control
shots.picture: 'Total control.' UI montage: the DAY card flips 1 -> 7 while sliders and toggles fan out (Gravity, Volume, Speed, Language, Graphics).
shots.camera: fast push 8%; elements stagger in 2-frame steps
shots.sfx: toggle x3 quick; slider_tick; success_chime on 'control'

shots.name: A5_noundo
shots.picture: 'No undo.' A big UNDO button cracks on 'undo' and falls off the bottom of the screen. Deadpan.
shots.camera: locked + 2% drift, tiny shake on the crack
shots.ui: undoButton crack 0 -> 1 on 'undo', fall with rotation
shots.sfx: glass_crack on 'undo'; slide_whistle_down; bonk off-screen just before the A6 glitch

shots.name: A6_day7wide
shots.picture: Day 7 flash-forward, wide: streetReset, the sky is a loading bar filling; red countdown pill pops 1:00. SYS 'Factory reset in one minute.'
shots.ui: timerPill red 1:00 pops; sky loading bar; red alert tint pulses
shots.sfx: glitch + impact_hit on the cut (music slam-back); alarm/siren bed low; countdown_beep on 'minute'; sub_boom on 'reset'

shots.name: A7_mannequins
shots.picture: Mom and Dad flicker into grey mannequins with DEFAULT tags, 3 flickers (normal/mannequin/normal/mannequin).
shots.camera: medium two-shot, push 3%, shake on each flicker
shots.ui: DEFAULT tags pop on each final state (anchor at toonHeadY*s)
shots.sfx: power_down x2 (short), glitch ticks; the riser into the A8 slam is in the music (src 18.78)

shots.name: A8_samdefense
shots.picture: Sam to camera (close-up, streetReset blurred behind, red light): 'In my defense... I only changed ONE thing.' Sweat drop grows through the line.
shots.faces: nervous -> on 'ONE' forced grin + one finger raised; lip-sync
shots.sfx: small whoosh on the punch; sweat bloop

shots.name: A9_counter412
shots.picture: SYS 'Changes made by you: four hundred and twelve.' A counter beside Sam's head rolls 1 -> 412 as she says it, lands on 'twelve'; Sam's eyes follow it; sweat doubles.
shots.ui: odometer counter, label 'Changes made by you'
shots.sfx: counter ticks (accelerating, countdown_beep[3]); error_buzz when it lands

shots.name: A10_ish
shots.picture: SAM '...Ish.' Tiny shrug, half-lid guilty eyes. Deadpan hold ~0.95 s after the word.
shots.sfx: - (music hard-stops on this cut; only the low alarm bed)

shots.name: B1_rewind
shots.picture: N 'Let's scroll back... seven days.' UNDO HISTORY panel: 412 changes scroll back at speed, day labels DAY 7 -> DAY 1; 2-3-frame flash-forwards (classroom, kitchen, gold lawn) graded lavender between rows.
shots.camera: panel locked to screen, background zooms; ends in a tape-stop freeze on 'days' end
shots.ui: undoHistory scroll (keep its blur out of glitch/<use>); rewind scanlines frame-sized
shots.sfx: vhs_rewind[3] engage on the cut; vhs_rewind bed; tape_stop at the end

shots.name: C1_bedtime
shots.picture: Bedroom at night, wide. Clock 2:13. Sam sits up in bed under the blanket, phone glow on his face, moonlight.
shots.faces: Sam wide awake, phone-lit (night tint + phone light)
shots.sfx: crickets bed; clock_tick; 12 O'Clock Magic first note on the cut

shots.name: C2_supposedly
shots.picture: Close on Sam's phone-lit face.
shots.faces: deadpan stare at the phone, one blink

shots.name: C3_appappears
shots.picture: Phone POV in bed: the phone rattles in his hand; the app card 'SETTINGS - for real life' pops with the gear.
shots.sfx: phone_vibrate[1]; notif_ping[0]; magic_shimmer[2]

shots.name: C4_terms
shots.picture: POV: Terms & Conditions card, page counter 1 / 4,812.
shots.sfx: popup_whoosh[0]

shots.name: C5_pagestack
shots.picture: Pages pour out of the phone and stack up past the ceiling (bedroom wider); the camera tilts up with the stack.
shots.camera: tilt up following the stack; counter ticks to 4,812 on 'pages'
shots.faces: Sam's eyes go up with it (scared)
shots.sfx: paper whooshes (whoosh_short x4), slide_whistle_up, thunk at the ceiling

shots.name: C6_squint
shots.picture: Sam squints seriously at page one.

shots.name: C7_flick
shots.picture: '...in half a second.' One flick: pages blur by; for 3 frames page 4,812 is readable: 'A reset can only be stopped by the loudest person in the house.'
shots.camera: whip-blur on the flick, freeze 3 frames on the rule, then on
shots.ui: termsPage fine print, highlight on the rule (captions sit at 92% so the page stays readable)
shots.sfx: swish; a tiny ding on the 3 frames

shots.name: C8_agree
shots.picture: POV: big green I AGREE, the thumb presses on 'AGREE'.
shots.sfx: ui_tap (big) on PRESS; music cuts to silence 0.25 s before the press

shots.name: C9_ripple
shots.picture: The ripple spreads out: room (white ripple through the bedroom) -> house (night street wide, the ring expands over the house) -> street. Snap zoom-outs x2.
shots.camera: snap zoom-outs x2, shake on the boom
shots.sfx: sub_boom[0] + bass_drop on the cut; shockwave whoosh_long[0]; Gotta Catch boot-up boops start 0.83 s before C10 (music plan)

shots.name: C10_welcome
shots.picture: SYS 'Welcome to Reality Settings!' Toast slides in on the music downbeat, the gear glows (over the night street).
shots.ui: welcomeToast slide + gear glow (land on TOAST)
shots.sfx: success_chime[0]; magic_shimmer[0]; popup_whoosh

shots.name: C11_proveit
shots.picture: SAM 'Prove it.' Mid-yawn, unimpressed (bed, phone-lit).
shots.faces: yawn -> bored half-lids; lip-sync on 'Prove it.'
shots.sfx: (the yawn is the voice; optional yawn SFX pitched up 4 st)

shots.name: C12_brightness
shots.picture: POV: Brightness slider fills the screen.
shots.sfx: popup_whoosh; ui_tap

shots.name: C13_slide
shots.picture: 'Slide it up.' POV: the thumb slides a little, 20% -> 35%.
shots.sfx: slider_drag[1]; riser[0] starts (peak on FLARE)

shots.name: C14_sunrise
shots.picture: The window: the moon flares into a sun on 'little', the room blows out white, birds wake up and sing.
shots.camera: push toward the window; white flash on FLARE
shots.sfx: riser peak + impact_hit[1] + magic_shimmer[1] on FLARE; morning_birds bed starts; tweets

shots.name: C15_dadsun
shots.picture: DAD 'Who turned on the SUN?!' Hallway, Dad in pyjamas shielding his eyes from the light.
shots.sfx: door_slam[0] on the cut (bedroom door opens)

shots.name: C16_phonelower
shots.picture: 'That's not the PHONE's brightness.' Sam slowly lowers the phone; star eyes fade to fear.
shots.sfx: slide_whistle_down (soft)

shots.name: C17_planet
shots.picture: 'That's the planet's.' Snap zoom out from the house to space (continuous, ~0.4 s, landing on 'planet's'): one side of Earth glows like a lamp. Hold ~0.9 s.
shots.camera: snap zoom out (continuous) from the house to space, then a slow 1-2% drift
shots.sfx: whoosh_long[1] (peak on the snap) into silence; one tiny tweet in space (gag); music hard-cut on this cut

shots.name: D1_day1
shots.picture: N 'Day one.' DAY 1 card slams in (impact at +0.12 s).
shots.sfx: whoosh_short (peak 1 frame early) + impact_hit[0] + sub_boom[3] on DAY1; music slams in on the same frame

music.note: (a) cold open: the title hit on frame 2 (measured: pre-swell from 0.80, attack 0.88, body 0.96-1.09; the map's 0.875 is the swell), its tonal tail under L001
tail fill under the A3 tree flip: hit-4 tail at the same decay point as hit 2's (0.8 s after peak; rms -16 dB, centroid 1.26 vs 1.36 kHz). Listen-check the 60 ms join
short tail fill (hit-4 tail 0.75 s after its peak) before hit 4

slam-back: the last 0.2 s of the 12.5-15.7 hi-hat swell rise INTO the A6 glitch cut, which lands on the track's own hard cut (15.70); then the Day 7 'drone' under L005 + A7 (measured: a ~1 kHz ring decaying -34 -> -44 LUFS, no sub content; gain set on the ring alone)
reversed riser 18.78-19.35 under the end of A7, full-band slam on the A8 cut, tension body under L006-L007 (ducked under voice); HARD STOP on the A10 cut before '...Ish.' (drop 2)
B1 rewind: the cold-open body we just heard, played BACKWARDS and sped up to fit B1 (rate = src span / entry length, pitch rises with it), low-passed, under the vhs_rewind bed; ends on the tape-stop
(b) 12 O'Clock Magic from the rewind's end: first note 0.315 on the C1 cut

jump-cut on the bar line 6.829 -> 14.215 (bar 3.14-6.83 matches the bar before 14.215: chroma similarity 0.98) so the 15.145 layer enters under the page stack; HARD CUT 0.25 s before the I AGREE press (drop 3)

(c) boot-up boops 1.595/1.795/1.995 + power-up sweep (0.83 s pickup at the end of the C9 ripple), groove downbeat 2.392 on the welcome toast; bright and dense, so 3 dB under the other beds; HARD CUT on the C17 cut (drop 4). Alternative if the pickup fights the ripple: src0 2.37
(d) Average Duck Face slams in with the DAY 1 card on its downbeat 8.87 (impact frame); fades over the last 0.3 s of the hook

drops.slam: 0.2 s of the Our Last Stand swell rising into the A6 glitch cut (its own hard cut at src 15.70 lands on the cut) + glitch[0] + impact_hit[1] (SFX) on the cut, then the ring
drops.note: music silent under 'undo' + the UNDO crack/fall (0.35 s of silence, then the 0.2 s swell: the board's 0.4 s drop; A6 cuts 0.55 s after 'undo' so the crack, fall and off-screen bonk fit)

drops.slam: B1: vhs_rewind engage + the reversed cold-open music (ols_rewind)
drops.note: hard stop on the A10 cut: '...Ish.' and its ~0.95 s hold play over the low alarm bed only

drops.slam: Gotta Catch boot-up boops -> groove downbeat on the welcome toast (TOAST)
drops.note: silence 0.25 s before the press, then the press tap + sub_boom + bass_drop + shockwave carry the ripple

drops.slam: Average Duck Face downbeat 8.87 on the DAY 1 card impact + impact_hit[0] + sub_boom[3]
drops.note: full drop under 'That's the planet's.' and the space hold; whoosh_long[1] and one tiny tweet fill it

beds.note: light suburban morning under the day street (A1-A3); cut with the A4 UI montage
low constant siren under the whole Day 7 flash-forward incl. the '...Ish.' hold; the rewind engage swallows it
the sky loading bar computing (dense corruption loop)
steady rewind whirr; pitch it up over the shot if the scroll accelerates (engage + tape_stop are shot cues)
2:13 a.m. outside the window, through the ripple and the night street; the sun kills it
the birds wake and sing (densest chirping) from the flare through the hallway; hard cut into space
